final_message:
Reproduced. `eslint . --fix` throws `EMFILE: too many open files` from `ESLint.outputFixes` when many files get fixed and the open-file limit is lower than the number of fixed files.

**Command** (from the repo root, no arguments needed):

    bash tools/recreate-emfile.sh

The script is `tools/recreate-emfile.sh`, untracked in the working tree. It generates 3000 files that each have two auto-fixable problems (`no-var`, `prefer-const`) in a temp dir. It runs `node bin/eslint.js . --fix` under `ulimit -n 1024` and then checks three things: no EMFILE in the output, exit status 0, and every file actually fixed. It exits 1 if any of these fail.

**What I saw on this checkout (ESLint 9.30.1, Node 22.22.0, Linux):** the command exits 1 with the same stack as the report:

    Error: EMFILE: too many open files, open '/tmp/tmp.uKCaE24pvR/f1902.js'
        at async open (node:internal/fs/promises:636:25)
        at async Object.writeFile (node:internal/fs/promises:1205:14)
        at async Promise.all (index 1004)
        at async ESLint.outputFixes (lib/eslint/eslint.js:533:3)
        at async Object.execute (lib/cli.js:637:4)

`outputFixes` maps every fixed result to `fs.writeFile(...)` inside one `Promise.all`. The failure shows up at about the 1000th write, close to the 1024 limit.

**Passes where the bug shouldn't occur** (same script, no code changes):
- `LIMIT=20000 bash tools/recreate-emfile.sh` runs the same 3000 files with a high limit. It exits 0 with all files fixed.
- `FILES=500 bash tools/recreate-emfile.sh` runs the same 1024 limit with fewer files. It exits 0 with all files fixed.

**Caveats:**
- I simulated the environment. The reporter was on Windows with about 9000 fixed files. I used Linux with a lowered `ulimit -n` and 3000 files, since the failure depends on files fixed versus the open-file limit. I did not try Windows.
- I didn't touch production code, so no fix is included. The only file I added is the repro script.
patch:
diff --git a/tools/recreate-emfile.sh b/tools/recreate-emfile.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..1fe4d12
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/recreate-emfile.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Reproduction for "running `eslint --fix` throws EMFILE: too many open files".
+# ESLint.outputFixes() starts one fs.writeFile() per fixed file inside a single
+# Promise.all(), so the number of simultaneously open files grows with the
+# number of fixed files. This generates FILES auto-fixable files and runs
+# `eslint . --fix` under a soft open-file limit of LIMIT (ulimit -n), which
+# stands in for the reporter's ~9000 fixed files on Windows.
+#
+# Exit status: non-zero while the bug is present, zero once `--fix` completes.
+# Usage (from repo root): bash tools/recreate-emfile.sh   (FILES=3000 LIMIT=1024 by default)
+set -u
+FILES=${FILES:-3000}
+LIMIT=${LIMIT:-1024}
+ROOT=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
+WORK=$(mktemp -d)
+trap 'rm -rf "$WORK"' EXIT
+
+cat > "$WORK/eslint.config.js" <<'CFG'
+module.exports = [{
+	files: ["**/*.js"],
+	languageOptions: { sourceType: "commonjs" },
+	rules: { "no-var": "error", "prefer-const": "error" }
+}];
+CFG
+for i in $(seq 1 "$FILES"); do
+	printf 'var a%d = 1;\nexports.x = a%d;\n' "$i" "$i" > "$WORK/f$i.js"
+done
+
+cd "$WORK" || exit 2
+( ulimit -n "$LIMIT" && node "$ROOT/bin/eslint.js" . --fix ) > "$WORK/.out" 2>&1
+STATUS=$?
+echo "files=$FILES ulimit -n=$LIMIT eslint --fix exit status=$STATUS"
+head -c 1500 "$WORK/.out"
+
+if grep -q EMFILE "$WORK/.out"; then
+	echo "BUG PRESENT: --fix failed with EMFILE: too many open files"
+	exit 1
+fi
+if [ "$STATUS" -ne 0 ]; then
+	echo "eslint --fix failed (exit $STATUS) without EMFILE"
+	exit 1
+fi
+UNFIXED=$(grep -L '^const ' "$WORK"/f*.js | wc -l)
+if [ "$UNFIXED" -ne 0 ]; then
+	echo "$UNFIXED of $FILES files were not fixed"
+	exit 1
+fi
+echo "OK: all $FILES files fixed, no EMFILE"
